data.exact_reserve_text: The estimates presented below in the 2023 financial statements were subject to a true-up mechanism with RiverStone during 2024 to finalise the balance. This true up process resulted in a GBP 27.1m charge in the profit and loss during the finalisation of the RITC and quota share arrangement. The tables below illustrate the development of the estimates of cumulative claims for the Syndicate on an underwriting year basis, illustrating how amounts booked have developed from one reporting period to the next. Due to RITC where the 2018 prior claims were ceded out to RiverStone, the claims table below only showing claims after underwriting year 2018. All tables are prepared on an undiscounted basis. To aid comparability, currency amounts have been converted using 2024 year end exchange rates.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsurance to close and quota share arrangements with RiverStone resulted in transfer/cessation of 2018 and prior liabilities and a true-up process that produced a charge to profit and loss on finalisation.
2018 and prior claims were ceded to RiverStone which caused the claims development table to exclude 2018 and distorted comparative movements.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves increased materially on a prior-year basis (gross strengthening of c.GBP 247.7m, ~14.5% of opening gross reserves). The movement reflects adverse development across years 2020-2022 (partly offset by a release on 2019) and has been influenced by reinsurance transactions with RiverStone (a split RITC and quota share) and a subsequent true-up which generated a GBP 27.1m charge on finalisation. The development affects reserves across the syndicate portfolio and the reinsurance/treaty arrangements and has distorted comparisons for 2018 and earlier years.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (31 Dec 2023 closing = opening for 2024). Prior-year movement calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative estimates) because no single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was present. Triangle is presented in GBP '000; movements converted to millions. Development table is affected by RiverStone RITC/Quota Share (2018 ceded) and a 2024 true-up; these RITC transactions may distort comparability. Where narrative net figures exist they were not used because gross source was available.
